gp.text: The Company has generated $7.9 million in revenues with $4.8 million in gross profit from its primary business for the three months ended June 30, 2026, as compared to no revenues for the three months ended June 30, 2025. The revenues are primarily related to development fees for BESS projects. Approximately $0.9 million is related to Solar development fees non-refundable deposit forfeited.

ga.text: General and administrative expenses have increased significantly, $2.4 million ($0.9 million non-cash) for the three months ended June 30, 2026, compared to the three months ended June 30, 2025. The primary increase was a non-cash expense of approximately $0.9 million of non-cash stock compensation. The other primary operating expense increases were approximately $0.5 million in investor relations expenses, $0.4 million in legal fees primarily related to BESS projects, $0.2 million payroll and board fees, and $0.2 million in contract services for Emergen Energy LLC.

net.text: For the six months ended June 30, 2026, cash used in operations was approximately $2.5 million, primarily driven by net loss of approximately $2.1 million and increases in accounts receivable of $2.8 million, significantly offset by $4.8 million non-cash expenses consisting of stock-based compensation of approximately $3.8 million and $1 million of intangible amortization and decreases in accounts payable and related-party accounts payable of approximately $0.8 million compared to approximately $0.5 million cash used by operations for the six months ended June 30, 2025, which primarily included the net loss of approximately $1.7 million and primarily offset by the non-cash stock-based compensation of $0.6 million and an increase in accounts payable (including related parties) of $0.5 million.

sbc.text: For the six months ended June 30, 2026, cash used in operations was approximately $2.5 million, primarily driven by net loss of approximately $2.1 million and increases in accounts receivable of $2.8 million, significantly offset by $4.8 million non-cash expenses consisting of stock-based compensation of approximately $3.8 million and $1 million of intangible amortization and decreases in accounts payable and related-party accounts payable of approximately $0.8 million compared to approximately $0.5 million cash used by operations for the six months ended June 30, 2025, which primarily included the net loss of approximately $1.7 million and primarily offset by the non-cash stock-based compensation of $0.6 million and an increase in accounts payable (including related parties) of $0.5 million.

wc.text: We plan to raise the working capital and project specific financing we need to commence the Development Projects through future debt and equity financing.

intro.text: Bimergen Energy Corporation (the “Company”, “Bimergen,” “Bitech,” “we” or “us”) was incorporated under the laws of Delaware on March 4, 1998. In connection with the Company’s planned expansion of its business following the completion of the acquisition of Bitech Mining Corporation, a Wyoming corporation (“Bitech Mining”), it amended to its Certificate of Incorporation on April 29, 2022 to change its corporate name to Bitech Technologies Corporation. On January 28, 2025, the Company filed a Certificate of Amendment to its Certificate to Incorporation to: (i) effect a reverse stock split of its common stock, par value $0.001 per share (the “Common Stock”) at a ratio of 1 post-split share for every 140 pre-split shares; and (ii) to change the name of the Company to Bimergen Energy Corporation.

lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Receivables
lines.why: Owed by customers for sales: operating.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Intangible assets
lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Deferred revenue
lines.why: Customers' payments ahead of delivery: operating.

lines.name: Other assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total assets minus the lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total liabilities minus the lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.
